Detected some missing optional indices. Occasionally new indices are added (by IONOS Nextcloud Workspace or installed applications) to improve database performance. Adding indices can sometimes take awhile and temporarily hurt performance so this is not done automatically during upgrades. Once the indices are added, queries to those tables should be faster. Use the command `occ db:add-missing-indices` to add them.
translations.If you use third party applications to c: If you use third party applications to connect to IONOS Nextcloud Workspace, please make sure to create and configure an app password for each before enabling second factor authentication.
translations.Incorrect row format found in your datab: Incorrect row format found in your database. ROW_FORMAT=Dynamic offers the best database performances for IONOS Nextcloud Workspace. Please update row format on the following list: %s.
translations.It seems like you are running a 32-bit P: It seems like you are running a 32-bit PHP version. IONOS Nextcloud Workspace needs 64-bit to run well. Please upgrade your OS and PHP to 64-bit!

translations.Nextcloud is not allowed to use the OPca: IONOS Nextcloud Workspace is not allowed to use the OPcache API. With OPcache enabled, it is highly recommended to include all IONOS Nextcloud Workspace directories with "opcache.restrict_api" or unset this setting to disable OPcache API restrictions, to prevent errors during IONOS Nextcloud Workspace core or app upgrades.
translations.OPcache is configured to remove code com: OPcache is configured to remove code comments. With OPcache enabled, "opcache.save_comments=1" must be set for IONOS Nextcloud Workspace to function.
translations.Oracle version \"%1$s\" detected. Oracle: Oracle version "%1$s" detected. Oracle >=%2$s and <=%3$s is suggested for best performance, stability and functionality with this version of IONOS Nextcloud Workspace.
Please make sure to set the "overwrite.cli.url" option in your config.php file to the URL that your users mainly use to access this IONOS Nextcloud Workspace. Suggestion: "%s". Otherwise there might be problems with the URL generation via cron. (It is possible though that the suggested URL is not the URL that your users mainly use to access this IONOS Nextcloud Workspace. Best is to double check this in any case.)

translations.Server identifier isn’t configured. It i: Server identifier isn’t configured. It is recommended if your IONOS Nextcloud Workspace instance is running on several PHP servers. Add a server ID in your configuration.
translations.The reverse proxy header configuration i: The reverse proxy header configuration is incorrect, or you are accessing IONOS Nextcloud Workspace from a trusted proxy. If not, this is a security issue and can allow an attacker to spoof their IP address as visible to the IONOS Nextcloud Workspace.

translations.This community release of Nextcloud is u: This community release of IONOS Nextcloud Workspace is unsupported and instant notifications are unavailable.
translations.You are accessing your instance over a s: You are accessing your instance over a secure connection, however your instance is generating insecure URLs. This likely means that your instance is behind a reverse proxy and the IONOS Nextcloud Workspace `overwrite*` config values are not set correctly.
translations.Your instance is generating insecure URL: Your instance is generating insecure URLs. If you access your instance over HTTPS, this likely means that your instance is behind a reverse proxy and the IONOS Nextcloud Workspace `overwrite*` config values are not set correctly.
